name: Gaius
desc: Gaius is a NPC that is a part of [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions), belonging to the 11th Scouting Legion. He's staying with his group composed of [Atra](entity:atra), Lars, [Caitus](entity:caitus) and [Amara](entity:amara) and rants about how he has the most potential in all of the [Legion](faction:the_hundred_legions) and shouldn't be stationed in the Etrean Luminant.
